stages.summary: Arbiter correctness calibration and selective delegation; Oracle direction certified safe.
Nexus correctness shown non-identifiable; the benchmark itself was the defect.
Value-aware Nexus: 0.0844 to 0.7826, still below the delegation floor.
No supported Nexus confidence region reaches the 0.99 floor.
Stability adds information but delegation reaches only 0.9894.
Residual errors decomposed; substitute misvaluation dominant.
Expert remediated 0.7909 to 0.8291; delegation ceiling unmoved.
Delegation tail is six cases and is not separable beyond a matched null.
Oracle characterized: one certified action head plus seven label-only diagnostics.
Vocabulary alignment; timeToThreshold exonerated, the benchmark was wrong.
Abstention redefined as data sufficiency; persistence 0.3432 to 0.8517.
Conflict gate real but unreachable; SUSTAINED_RUN corpus 15% mislabelled.
All 21 generator families boundary-audited; three repaired; persistence 0.8818 to 0.9392.

ownedLimitations.detail: Both routes to the 0.99 floor are closed: a better expert does not reach it, and neither does a better confidence rule over the current representation.
Only the direction head has an action-delegation path; the other seven emit labels. Widening it is an Arbiter decision, not a measurement.
The gate is structurally over-abstention but fires on 0 of 3,520 swept cases and 0 of the corpus, so there is nothing to repair.
Six families fail somewhere in their declared parameter range at points the certification corpus never samples. Ranges recorded, not narrowed.

stage2lClosureCertificate.note: A record of what the arc concluded. It restates no historical certification and changes none. Every prior stage artifact remains byte-identical.

dependencies.description: The ZekNova runtime root, needed by lineage verification and every live-parity path.
dependencies.resolution: Explicit ZEKNOVA_ROOT through ZEKNOVA_ROOT_CONTRACT_V1; no default, no search, fail-closed with a named reason.

dependencies.description: 28 entry points fell back to one developer's Desktop path when the variable was unset, turning a missing dependency into an anonymous ENOENT.
dependencies.resolution: Default removed everywhere; the binding is now null when unset and the contract decides what happens next.

dependencies.description: scripts/sentinel-grid-mainline-status.sh and scripts/sentinel-grid-mainline-verify.sh hardcoded absolute Desktop paths for BOTH repositories, so the mainline entry points only ran on one machine.
dependencies.resolution: The Sentinel root is derived from the script location; the ZekNova root must be declared and is checked before use, with exit 2 and a named reason when it is not.

dependencies.description: integration/status.mjs defaulted both roots to os.homedir()/Desktop/... — a machine assumption rather than a default, and invisible to a literal-path scan.
dependencies.resolution: Sentinel derives from the module location; ZekNova comes from --zeknova or ZEKNOVA_ROOT and is never inferred.

dependencies.description: integration/mainline-integration.json and integration/targets/zeknova.json record the absolute paths of a past install.
dependencies.resolution: Left unchanged. They are a record of where an install happened, not a source anyone resolves a path from; rewriting them would falsify the record without making anything portable.

dependencies.description: tests/evidence-portability.test.js uses '/Users/example/project' to assert that absolute paths are NOT encoded into evidence.
dependencies.resolution: Left unchanged on purpose. Replacing it would delete the assertion it exists to make.

dependencies.description: A tracked, executable copy of the Stage 2F.4E.3G R8-R4 forensic review script sits at the repository root under a filename consisting of a single space, and builds every path from $HOME/Desktop/... It is a near-duplicate of .tmp-r8-r4/stage2f4e3g-r8-r4-final-review.sh and nothing references it.
dependencies.resolution: Recorded, not repaired and not deleted. It is on no execution path, so it is not a portability defect of the running system; it is an accidentally committed artifact whose removal is a repository-hygiene decision, not this stage's to make. Named here so it is excluded knowingly rather than missed.

dependencies.description: .tmp-r8-r3-r2/MANUAL_APPLY.sh carries developer paths from an earlier runtime rebuild.
dependencies.resolution: Not on any execution path and excluded from the production bundle. Left as historical scratch.

dependencies.description: Sentinel roots are derived from import.meta.dirname rather than hardcoded.
dependencies.resolution: Already portable; relative to the module, so the repository can live anywhere.

dependencies.description: Tests that need scratch space use os.tmpdir() rather than a fixed directory.

dependencies.note: Not every absolute path is a defect. A fixture that asserts a path is never leaked must keep its path to keep testing.

rootContract.note: One variable, no default, no search. Structural validity (is this a ZekNova root) is decided separately from lineage identity (is it the certified one), because a resolver that answered both would refuse a legitimate root for having drifted.

pathIndependence.note: Two byte-identical trees at unrelated roots — one nested and containing a space — must produce one identity, and a single changed byte must break it. Either half alone would be worthless: a constant would pass the first and a path-dependent digest would pass the second.

cases.description: the variable is not set at all
cases.reason: ZEKNOVA_ROOT is not set. ZekNova-dependent certification cannot run without an explicit binding; it is never inferred.

cases.description: the variable is set to an empty string
cases.reason: ZEKNOVA_ROOT is not set. ZekNova-dependent certification cannot run without an explicit binding; it is never inferred.

cases.description: the variable points at a path that does not exist
cases.reason: ZEKNOVA_ROOT points at <TMP>/no-such-dir, which is not a readable directory.
<TMP>/empty does not look like a ZekNova runtime root: 4 of 4 structural markers are missing.

cases.description: a repository carrying some but not all structural markers
cases.reason: <TMP>/wrong-repository does not look like a ZekNova runtime root: 1 of 4 structural markers are missing.

cases.description: the variable points at a file
cases.reason: ZEKNOVA_ROOT points at <TMP>/a-file, which is not a readable directory.

cases.description: a valid root whose path contains a space
a valid root with surrounding whitespace

adversarialRoots.note: Every refusal carries a named status and reason. No case reaches a raw ENOENT, which was the inherited defect.

currentLineage.reason: ZEKNOVA_ROOT is not set. ZekNova-dependent certification cannot run without an explicit binding; it is never inferred.
currentLineage.note: No lineage is asserted. A classification produced without reading the runtime would be a guess wearing a certification label.

contractCompatibility.reason: ZEKNOVA_ROOT is not set. ZekNova-dependent certification cannot run without an explicit binding; it is never inferred.
contractCompatibility.note: Contract compatibility is a statement about the real runtime. With none bound, every surface is unmeasured rather than assumed compatible.

invocationIndependence.note: One platform, several invocation roots. This is NOT a multi-platform claim and must never be reported as one; no second operating system was available to this run.

suite.note: Before this stage the ZekNova-dependent test failed on a missing developer path. It now skips with a named reason. A skip that says why is a measurement; a failure that says ENOENT is not.

portabilityStatus.note: MULTI_ROOT_SAME_PLATFORM_CERTIFIED. The repository is invocation-independent and root-independent on this platform. No second operating system was reachable, so the inherited DIGEST_PRODUCED_SINGLE_PLATFORM limitation is carried forward unchanged rather than closed. Environment independence and platform diversity are different claims and this stage only earned the first.

readiness.note: Live qualification is not ready. Blocking gates: CURRENT_LINEAGE_IDENTIFIED, OBSERVATION_CONTRACT_COMPATIBLE.

leanBundle.recommendation: Rebuild as a NEW artifact pinned to this stage if a portable bundle is wanted. Do not overwrite the 2L.19 bundle: it is the object an earlier delivery refers to.
leanBundle.note: "Lean" describes packaging, not authority. The bundled system is R0 advisory-only, confers no dispatch capability, and shipping it does not promote anything.

interpretation.measuredRemainingLimitation: CURRENT_ZEKNOVA_LINEAGE_NOT_MEASURED_IN_THIS_ENVIRONMENT: no ZekNova runtime is reachable here, so lineage classification, observation-contract compatibility and live-qualification readiness are unmeasured rather than assumed. The machinery for all three is built and exercised against fixtures.

Environment independence and platform diversity are different claims and this stage only earned the first.
